verdict.rationale: Runway Dev documents an async job API. Developers send a request such as `POST /v1/text_to_video`, receive a task id, and poll `GET /v1/tasks/{id}` until it reaches `SUCCEEDED` or `FAILED`. An SDK, cURL examples and an OpenAPI 3.1 spec are documented, and probes confirmed the spec and llms.txt are live. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of how the finished asset is returned or downloaded (output URL format, expiry), and independent hands-on corroboration of a full submit-and-retrieve run.
